strings.물건을 찾아서 루맨에 있는 사람에게 전해줬어요. 이번에도 비슷한 방법으로: I found the object and returned it to someone in Lumen. I think we can find the next one the same way...
strings.어떻게 그걸 알아낸 거예요? 그런 물건을 찾아낼 수 있다고 알게 된 거예: How did you work that out? How did you know we could find things that way?
strings.비밀은 아니고, 저도 잘 모르겠어요. 어떻게…라고 한다면 말씀드리기 어려: It's no secret, but I don't really know either. It's hard to explain how...
strings.이곳에 오래 있으면서 정령들을 통해서 정보를 얻은 것 때문에 알게 된 것: I think I learned it from all the information the spirits have given me during my long time here.
strings.정 궁금하시면 이곳에서 몇백 년 정도 머무시는 건 어떠세요?: If you're that curious, why not stay here for a few centuries?
I am curious, but somehow that doesn't appeal to me.
I thought you might say that.
strings.이번엔 어디로 가야 하죠, 아르케?: Where should I go this time, Arche?
strings.최근에 다녀오신 곳 중에서 제일 의문점이 남는 곳이 어디인가요?: Of the places you've visited recently, which left you with the most questions?
strings.크노소스…라고 오래전 수인 제국의 영토였어요. 거기서 많은 일들이 일어난: Knossos... It was once part of the beastman empire. A great deal seems to have happened there, but I could learn very little.
strings.아르케가 여기에 오기 전 프레이오스와 이스트랜드를 갔었잖아요. 그래서 말: You visited Freios and Eastland before coming here, didn't you? Have you ever been to Knossos?
I don't know. Whether I went and don't remember, or never went at all...
I've remembered my time as the Weaver, but not all of it.
strings.그래도 최대한 생각해볼게요. 당장은 아니라도… %s 님에게 도움이 된다면: Still, I'll try to remember as much as I can. Even if not right away... If it helps you, %s...
I'm sorry, Arche. I was only thinking of myself.
Not at all. Go and have a look. You may find something out.
I will. Straight to Knossos, then.
Turning up out of nowhere... You want information from me.
I said to visit often if you wanted to build trust. Such an obedient little butcher of the goddess.
I came to ask you something.
For nothing? Let's help each other. If you want something from me, show your hand.
strings.(탈로스가 %s에게서 봉투를 받아 들고 의아해한다.): (Talos takes the bag from %s with a puzzled look.)
I picked up litter on the way here from the outpost. Pulled a few weeds too.
Damn... You've done exactly what I like best...
If you've gone that far, I'll at least hear you out.
strings.그러면 이야기할게요. 최근에 뭐 잃어버린 거 있어요?: Then let me ask. Have you lost anything recently?
No. Nothing. Satisfied? Off you go.
strings.저기, 저기. 잠깐만요. 아니면, 잃어버린 물건을 찾고 있는 사람이라도요: Wait, wait. Just a moment. Do you know anyone looking for something they've lost?
strings.최근에 잃어버린 건 아니지만, 찾고 싶은 건 있지. 꼭 내 것이라 하기도: Not something lost recently, but there's something I'd like to find. Though it's hard to call it mine...
strings.(뭔지 알 것 같기도 하고…. 아, 나르샤!): (I think I know what he means... Oh, Narsha!)
If there's nothing, then never mind.
strings.너무 쉽게 납득하는 것 같은데? 갈 곳이 정해졌나 봐?: You accepted that rather easily. Decided where to go next?
strings.세상을 구한 기분을 묻고 싶지만, 뭐 뻔하겠지. 세상은 계속해서 무너질: I'd ask how it feels to have saved the world, but I can guess. The world will keep facing ruin. I wonder what you'll do. It should be interesting.
I might be part of it myself.
strings.지금은 그다지 하고 싶지 않은데? 다음에는 쓰레기봉투 하나로는 안 될 거: I don't particularly feel like it now. Next time, one bag of rubbish won't be enough.
Sigh. Can't be helped. I'll leave, then.
strings.후우…. 마녀들 일로 온 줄 알았는데, 아니었군. 그래도 조심하는 수밖에: Sigh... I thought this was about the witches, but apparently not. Still, I'd better be careful...
strings.잘 있었어요, 나르샤? 별일 없었죠?: Have you been well, Narsha? No trouble?
strings.네, 별일은 없어요. 선생님, 아니 모험가님께서 신경 써주셔서 요즘은 나: No trouble. Since you've been looking out for me, Teacher—I mean, Adventurer—nothing bad has happened lately.
strings.선생님이라 부르는 건 그만하는 건가요?: You're not calling me Teacher anymore?
Oh, well... I got told off.
He said I should only call someone that when they've actually taught me. I'm sorry.
strings.아니에요, 괜찮아요. 지금 대화 괜찮아요?: It's all right. Do you have time to talk?
strings.저는 대화하는 거 좋아해요. 그런데 무슨 일이세요?: I like talking. What's the matter?
strings.최근에 잃어버리거나 찾고 있는 물건 같은 거 있어요?: Have you lost anything recently, or been looking for something?
I haven't lost anything, but I am looking for something. A book...
A book containing a story my mother, a Sister, told me when I was little.
strings.어떤 이야기인지 들을 수 있을까요?: Could you tell me the story?
strings.(나르샤가 눈을 감고 기억을 더듬기 시작한다.): (Narsha closes her eyes and searches her memories.)
strings.정확하진 않지만, 그런 내용이었어요. 어린아이가 숲을 걷고 있었는데, 길: I don't remember exactly, but it went something like this. A child was walking through a forest and lost their way. Then they met a golem, and the two played together.
After several days of playing together, a wicked fairy appeared before the child.
strings.요정은 골렘이랑 놀지 말고 같이 원래 있던 곳으로 돌아가자고 했죠. 골렘: The fairy said to stop playing with the golem and return home together. The golem thought it would be better for the child to go with the fairy than stay, and sent the child away...
I think it ended with the golem left all alone.
Thinking about my situation lately brought the story to mind...
strings.(나르샤와 마도골렘이 생각나기도 하고, 오네이로 숲의 베르겔미르와 에다: (It reminds me of Narsha and her magic golem. And of Bergelmir and Eda in Oneiro Forest...)
strings.이 이야기는 이곳을 비롯해서 실바리아 제국 사람들이라면 웬만큼 아는 구전: It's an old tale most people here and in the Silvaria Empire know.
strings.벨파 도서관에 문의를 해봤는데, 벨파 도서관엔 없는 책이래요. 발간되기는: I asked Belpa Library, but they don't have it. It was published so long ago, and so few copies remain, they said it would be hard to find.
strings.아, 저도 한번 찾아볼게요. 요즘 왔다 갔다 하는 곳이 있어서…. 그래도: Oh, I'll look for it too. I've been traveling somewhere lately... But don't get your hopes up.
strings.말씀만으로도 감사해요, 선생님. 아니…, 모험가님!: Thank you just for offering, Teacher. I mean... Adventurer!
strings.혹시라도 나중에 책을 찾으시면 테오 아저씨에게 주세요. 아무래도 아저씨가: If you do find it, please give it to Uncle Theo. I think it would be best to have him check it first.
I will. I have somewhere to go, so I'll be off. See you later.
Thank you for visiting when you're so busy.
strings.(나르샤가 기뻐하자 어깨에 있던 마도골렘 마도리도 신나게 움직이는 것 같: (As Narsha brightens, the magic golem Madori on her shoulder seems to move excitedly too.)
Could Kairos help me find the book...? Hmm. Only one way to find out.
strings.(바로 앞에 보이는 나무 앞에서 엎어져 자고 있던 카이로스가 일어나 눈을: (Kairos rises from where he was sleeping by the nearby tree and wubs his eyes. Ahem, rubs his eyes.)
I think I figured out what drifted in here.
strings.아르케에게 듣긴 들었는데, 귀찮은 일이넹. 그래서 그 물건이 뭐양?: Arche told me. What a bother. So what's the thing, mew?
I think it's a book about the friendship between a child and a golem.
strings.크로노스가 있는 곳에서는 어떻게 물건을 찾았어?: How did you find the object where Chronos was?
He said it had drifted into a deeper domain, and I needed 'permission.'
strings.(카이로스가 품 안에서 책 한 권을 꺼내서 흔들어 보인다.): (Kairos pulls a book out of his clothing and waves it.)
I was having a nice long sleep without a care, and a book dropped out of the tree. Plop.
Oh, perfect. Give it here. I'll take it out with me.
strings.허락이 필요행. 원래 깊은 영역까지 흘러 들어갔어야 했는데, 여기 있는: You need permission. It should have drifted into a deeper domain. If it's here, something must have gone awry.
strings.길게 설명하지 않아도 되니 참 좋넹. 귀찮았는데…. 나도 귀찮지만, 대련: How nice not to explain at length. Such a bother... I don't like it either, but we have to spar. Understood, mew?
Find your way there. I'm off.
Now I'm feeling sleepy too, mew... I want a nap...
strings.아, 아니지. 그러면 정신 차리고 가볼까?: Oh, no. Stay focused. Shall we go?
strings.(카이로스가 책을 꺼내 %s에게 건네준다.): (Kairos takes out the book and hands it to %s.)
strings.나는 부엉이 시계하고 달라서 그냥 쿨하게 준당. 이것도 어쩌면 네 중요한: I'm different from that owl clock. I just hand it over without a fuss. Maybe this is an important moment of choice for you, too.
strings.책을 받는 것뿐인데, 왜 중요한 거라고 말하는 거야?: I'm only accepting a book. Why call it important?
Actually, I don't know either. I'm the spirit in charge here, so I felt I should say something like that.
strings.그런 셈이징. 이거 그런데 무슨 내용의 책이냥? 가지고 있었지만, 보지는: Something like that. What's the book about, anyway, mew? I had it, but never read it...
strings.인간의 언어로 써져 있지? 읽어줄랭?: It's written in human language, right? Will you read it to me?
strings.엉. 나도 내용이 궁금했어. 별로 두껍지도 않으니까 금방 읽을 수 있을: Sure. I'm curious too. It's thin, so it shouldn't take long.
strings.「마녀와 골렘」, 마녀와 골렘?: 'The Witch and the Golem.' The witch and the golem?
strings.(카이로스가 놀라 %s의 손에서 책을 빼앗는다.): (Startled, Kairos snatches the book from %s's hands.)
strings.복잡해질 수도 있다…. 가이아 님도 원하지 않으실 거고, '허락'을 내린: Things could get complicated... Lady Gaia wouldn't want that, nor would the being who granted 'permission.'
If you want to read it, please do so among humans.
Be careful from now on. We don't know what might happen. Here.
strings.(카이로스가 걱정스러운 표정으로 다시 책을 건네준다.): (Looking concerned, Kairos hands the book back.)
strings.이 책이 여기 오게 된 건 누군가 의도적으로 꾸민 일이란 거지?: Someone deliberately arranged for it to come here, didn't they?
strings.그것까진 모르겠엉. 하여튼, 조심해야 해. 앞으로 무슨 일이 일어날지 모: I don't know that much. But you must be careful. I don't know what will happen.
strings.…운명의 순간이 꼬이면 안 되잖앙. 그리고 중요하다고 생각되는 순간을 놓: ...We can't let the moments of fate become tangled. And don't overlook any moment you feel is important.
I'll be going, Kairos. Thank you for worrying about me.
strings.(시간의 영역에서 모험가의 흔적이 사라지고 나서야 카이로스가 천천히 발걸: (Only after every trace of the adventurer leaves the Domain of Time does Kairos slowly move away. Then, as if remembering something, he gazes sadly at the sky of time.)
It feels as though the time Lady Gaia feared is slipping through the cracks...
Ah! You're here. Forgive me. I was thinking about something...
I found the book Narsha asked about. She told me to give it to you...
strings.아, 그래? 그 책을 내게 주겠나?: Oh, did she? May I have it?
strings.(테오도르가 책을 받아 훑어보더니 말을 이어가지 못한다.): (Theodore takes the book and leafs through it, then falls silent.)
strings.이건 나를 포함해 많은 사람들이 알고 있는 옛이야기지. 아, 자넨 외지인: This is an old story familiar to me and many others. Though as an outsider, you may not know it...
strings.숲에서 길을 헤매던 아이 앞에 나타난 골렘이 나타났고, 사이좋게 놀다가: A child lost in a forest meets a golem. They play together until a wicked fairy appears and tells the child to stop playing with it and come home...
strings.그 정도면 거의 정확하네. 이 이야긴 많은 사람들의 입에 내려오면서 조금: That's more or less right. The story must have changed little by little as it passed from person to person.
Unlike what Narsha expects, this book seems to preserve much of the original account... Disguised as a fairy tale...
It isn't long. I'll briefly explain how I read it.
strings.혼돈의 하늘 이전과 이후, 프레이오스는 많이 달라졌지. 전쟁으로 인해 패: Freios changed greatly before and after the Sky of Chaos. Wars for dominance saw many powers rise and fall.
strings.그중엔 인간들만 있었던 게 아니였어. 인간들의 욕심은 다른 존재들 또한: And humans weren't the only ones involved. Human greed exploited other beings too.
Ah, don't repeat this elsewhere. It's something of a taboo...
strings.아이는 길을 잃은 게 아니야. 도망친 거지. 골렘을 만나 같이 논 게 아: The child wasn't lost. The child had escaped. And they weren't playing with the golem, but desperately avoiding its attacks.
The fairy tale describes that as playing together...
There are beings called witches in Freios. They are different in nature from the female demons of the Demon Realm. They rarely reveal themselves, but those who do pursue their own affairs.
strings.내가 보기에 이 동화 속 아이는 마녀들로부터 마을을 살리기 위한 선물…,: To me, the child in this tale seems to be a gift... no, a sacrifice to save a village from the witches.
strings.골렘은 마녀가 만들었겠지. 아이가 도망가지 못하도록 하는 문지기 같은 거: The witch probably made the golem, a gatekeeper to prevent the child from escaping. On the surface, it looks like a fairy tale about a child and golem's friendship...
strings.이건 마녀의 이야기일 뿐…. 어쩌면 마녀가 아이에게서 바라는 게 뭔가 있: But it is simply a witch's story... Perhaps there was something the witch wanted from the child.
strings.예를 들면 이 아이가 마녀가 되길 바랐다던가, 이미 마녀인 아이를 알아봤: Perhaps she wanted the child to become a witch, or recognized that the child already was one...
That's one way to read it...
strings.…나르샤는 왜 이 책에 대해 궁금했던 걸까요?: ...Why was Narsha so curious about this book?
strings.그저 순수하게 알고 싶었을 거야. 자기가 데리고 있는 마도골렘을 비롯해서: She probably had a simple desire to understand. Her magic golem, and even her own identity...
She must have a lot on her mind...
Much has happened lately. Sigh... I'll keep this book. I'll find some explanation to give Narsha later.
strings.그렇게 하세요. 그리고 나르샤에게, 아니 여기 있는 분들에게 무슨 일이: All right. And please tell me right away if anything happens to Narsha—or to anyone here.
strings.자네 일로도 바쁠 텐데, 괜찮은가?: Aren't you busy enough with your own affairs?
Thank you... If you need my help, come without hesitation.
I'll be going, then. See you again, Theo.
strings.(모험가가 떠나고 책을 다시 살펴보던 테오도르가 마지막 페이지에서 시선을: (After the adventurer leaves, Theodore examines the book again. His gaze stops on the final page.)
strings.흠, 이 글자는 뭐라고 쓴 거지?: Hmm. What do these letters say?
An old imperial cipher? I should try putting it together.
strings.힐다에게…? 힐다…, 사람 이름인 건가?: 'To Hilda'...? Hilda... Is that someone's name?
